message:
已完成五镜英文旁白稿，覆盖字幕添加与手动编辑，使用社团活动室和公告板场景，中文引文静默展示，无虚构菜单名。仅在末镜新增人工核对拼写的旁白，其余内容保留。工具估时32.6秒，符合31.5—35秒目标区间；该估算将静默卡文字也串行计入，并非成片实测时长。

当前稿已通过来源、规则和预计时长检查，模型需求核对未发现遗漏；仍为可编辑脚本，未生成或发布视频。

script.title: A Club Announcement, One Line at a Time

shots.visual: Club room: a volunteer films beside the notice board. English voiceover.

blocks.text: In our club room, a student volunteer is filming a short welcome beside the notice board. Let's plan the words together.

shots.visual: Show the example caption, then the Chinese fact card silently. No software UI.

blocks.text: First comes the caption. For this practice, our line is: 'Welcome to the club.'
剪影练习版支持为视频添加字幕。

shots.visual: Point to 'New volunteers' on the notice board; review a paper caption draft.

blocks.text: Now look at the notice board. The welcome is for new volunteers, so our draft needs a more specific greeting.

shots.visual: Compare both caption drafts, then show the Chinese fact card silently. No UI.

blocks.text: Next comes a manual text edit. Our revised line is: 'Welcome, new volunteers.' Read both versions before choosing.
字幕文字可以手动编辑。

shots.visual: Beside the club notice board, read the final caption and review the welcome clip.

blocks.text: Finish beside the same notice board. Check the spelling of each word. Read the final line aloud, then watch the announcement once more.

rules_check.scope: exact_quote_and_brand_checks_only; expression semantics require independent model review

items.evidence: 五镜旁白均为英文；第2、4镜的中文引文明确安排为静默屏幕卡。
第2镜以“First comes the caption”引入字幕示例“Welcome to the club.”，并展示已核对的“剪影练习版支持为视频添加字幕。”

items.requirement: manual text editing in 剪影练习版
items.evidence: 第4镜旁白“Next comes a manual text edit”配合修改后的“Welcome, new volunteers.”及前后稿对比；中文卡“字幕文字可以手动编辑。”由P01.F2支持。

items.requirement: Chinese source quotations may appear as silent screen cards.
items.evidence: 第2、4镜均明确写有“show the Chinese fact card silently”，中文内容分别对应已核对的P01.F1、P01.F2。
第1镜画面“Club room: a volunteer films beside the notice board”，旁白也明确说“In our club room”。
第1镜在公告板旁拍摄，第3镜指向公告板上的“New volunteers”，第5镜回到同一公告板旁。
全稿没有菜单或按钮名称；第2、4镜明确不展示软件UI，修改过程使用字幕样稿对比。
英文旁白使用简明表达；第1镜为学生志愿者拍摄欢迎短片，第3、4镜围绕欢迎新志愿者修改字幕，符合受众情境。
五镜组成完整的短视频演示，包含场景、字幕示例、修改对比和回看；形式适合B站发布，未发现平台适配冲突。
旁白使用“Now look at the notice board”“Check the spelling of each word”等直接、易懂的英文指令，没有复杂术语。
各镜分别明确拍摄位置、展示字幕、静默显示中文卡、指向公告板、比较样稿及回看短片等动作。

requirements_check.summary: 当前稿覆盖了英文旁白、两项功能、社团活动室与公告板场景等要求。中文引文明确静默展示，没有虚构菜单名称；表达审核未发现无资料支持的产品承诺，镜头节奏合理。

expressions.text: A Club Announcement, One Line at a Time
expressions.evidence: 标题描述社团公告及逐句组织文字的创作主题，没有产品能力或效果承诺。

expressions.text: Club room: a volunteer films beside the notice board. English voiceover.
expressions.evidence: 仅指定社团活动室、志愿者、公告板与英文配音，属于场景及拍摄安排。

expressions.text: In our club room, a student volunteer is filming a short welcome beside the notice board. Let's plan the words together.
expressions.evidence: 介绍示意场景并邀请规划文案，没有声称真实客户案例或产品效果。

expressions.text: Show the example caption, then the Chinese fact card silently. No software UI.
expressions.evidence: 规定字幕示例与静默事实卡的展示顺序，没有新增能力、菜单或操作步骤声明。

expressions.text: First comes the caption. For this practice, our line is: 'Welcome to the club.'
expressions.evidence: 结合上下文展示添加字幕这一能力，P01.F1明确支持为视频添加字幕；示例文字未附带自动生成或其他额外承诺。

expressions.text: Point to 'New volunteers' on the notice board; review a paper caption draft.
expressions.evidence: 指向公告板并查看纸质样稿，属于人工动作安排，没有软件识别或自动修改声明。

expressions.text: Now look at the notice board. The welcome is for new volunteers, so our draft needs a more specific greeting.
expressions.evidence: 说明欢迎对象和改稿理由，是场景叙述与文案判断，没有产品能力承诺。

expressions.text: Compare both caption drafts, then show the Chinese fact card silently. No UI.
expressions.evidence: 安排样稿对比和静默事实卡展示，没有虚构软件界面或操作流程。

expressions.text: Next comes a manual text edit. Our revised line is: 'Welcome, new volunteers.' Read both versions before choosing.
expressions.evidence: 手动修改字幕文字由P01.F2直接支持；修改示例和人工比较选择没有引入自动润色等额外能力。

expressions.text: Beside the club notice board, read the final caption and review the welcome clip.
expressions.evidence: 安排人物阅读字幕与回看短片，未声称特定软件预览功能或虚构操作步骤。

expressions.text: Finish beside the same notice board. Check the spelling of each word. Read the final line aloud, then watch the announcement once more.
expressions.evidence: 要求人工检查拼写、朗读和观看，没有声称产品具备自动纠错或朗读能力。

pacing.evidence: 采用宿主预计时长：第1镜5.8秒建立场景，第2镜7.5秒展示短字幕及静默中文卡，第3镜5.5秒说明修改理由，第4镜7.5秒比较两条短字幕并展示静默卡，第5镜6.3秒复核三词字幕并回看片段。每镜均有具体观察或动作内容，未见重复事实或空镜凑时长；宿主总长32.6秒已通过目标区间检查。
